attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: individual Palari V2 character study

Primary request: Create one original Palari. Palari means Personal Artificial Intelligence. A Palari is a small crafted ceramic vessel whose single colored interior reveals its unique intelligence. This character belongs to a coherent species, not a human, conventional robot, toy wearing clothes, or household vessel.

Selected design:
- identity: fluted stone column with paired crown lobes, green oval, and greeting arm
- silhouette: tall slender column with a subtly flared stable base; make the column visibly fluted through broad continuous exterior curvature, not decorative grooves or extra pieces
- crown: restrained split-petal crown with two broad rounded lobes and smooth finished edges; one crown, not an open bowl
- opening: exactly one deliberate vertical oval aperture revealing a deep forest-green interior (#174D38)
- pose: one curved arm raised in greeting, ending in one seamless oval tip; the other rounded arm rests close to the body
- expression: quietly confident
- exterior material: balanced warm medium-grey stoneware, clearly grey rather than brown
- characteristic color: deep forest green, visually one hue only

Family invariants:
- one complete isolated figure with a stable continuous ceramic base
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
- exactly one characteristic hue, limited to the recessed inner intelligence, iris accents, and Palari seed mark
- one dominant architecturally intentional opening and at most one small supporting reveal
- calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, characteristic-color iris accents, and tiny catchlights
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy
- the Palari seed mark must be clearly visible and contain exactly six circular apertures: four larger circular apertures at the corners of one compact rectangle plus exactly two smaller apertures centered vertically between them; no extra seed dots
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges
- overall body height at least 2.4 times visible face height; never chibi or baby-like

Scene: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.
Composition: eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion; direct 1:1 square; one character only; full body and stable base completely visible; centered; occupying about 76 percent of image height.
Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow. Preserve readable ceramic form and inner depth without neon glow.

Avoid: simple horizontal bowl or cup rim, fingers, thumbs, palms, fingernails, or realistic hands, conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, or shoes, human skin, hair, clothing, jewelry, or demographic costume shorthand, multiple characteristic colors, rainbow effects, or neon glow, robot joints, screens, wires, exposed machinery, or appliance details, random holes or more than one dominant opening, cracks, chips, broken rims, dirt, or antique distressing, cups, mugs, vases, planters, lamps, speakers, or household appliances, generic mascot smiles, chibi proportions, horror, or vacant doll eyes, an upward-facing cavity on a crescent or a circular aperture surrounding the face, a stack silhouette without two visibly offset interlocking exterior masses, text, labels, numbers, logos, or watermarks.
attempts.review: Rejected: the seed contained only five visible apertures (four large corner apertures plus one small center aperture).

attempts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: Palari V2 avatar icon
Primary request: Derive a logo-first icon for the fluted column Palari in Image 1. Preserve the paired broad rounded split-petal crown lobes, tall slightly flared column, one long vertical oval aperture, one greeting arm and one resting arm. Normalize the shell to #E9E6DF and use forest #174D38 as the sole characteristic color. Emerge from the lower-left.

Input image: Image 1 is identity reference only. Do not edit it. Preserve its unique outer shell/aperture silhouette, crown treatment, arm pose, two calm eyes, and small Palari seed as identity cues. Do not inherit the plaster alcove, floor, camera realism, ceramic texture, material color, lighting, or shadows.

Create one highly simplified IP mascot LOGO candidate, not a character illustration.
Canvas/background: direct 1:1 square with square outer corners; fully opaque edge-to-edge perfectly uniform solid deep navy #172333; no vignette, halo, gradient, texture, floor, scene, frame, border, white margin, App mask, or transparency.
Color count: exactly three semantic colors in the complete logo, and no others: warm ivory #E9E6DF for the entire shell and both arms; the assigned characteristic color for the single continuous recessed aperture, both minimal eye marks, and the small Palari seed; #172333 only for the background. Same-family continuous micro-volume is allowed within the two IP colors but must not create additional swatches or hues.
Geometry: one dominant continuous rounded shell silhouette built from 6–10 broad basic shapes. The exact six-aperture Palari seed is the sole permitted repeated micro-detail: four larger corner dots and two smaller dots centered vertically, all characteristic-color, compact and subordinate. Two eyes only, no mouth. Exactly two rounded fingerless tubular arms with broad blunt ends; no hands, fingers, legs, feet, human anatomy, costume, machinery, decorative marks, or thin lines.
Composition: upright, emerging from the assigned lower corner, filling 75–85% of the canvas. Keep the crown and both arms visible. Make it readable as a black silhouette and unmistakable at true 32 × 32.
Style: flat-first vector-friendly geometry with one uninterrupted low-frequency diffuse gradient per large IP region, sharing one upper-left-to-lower-right light direction. Each transition spans at least half the dominant form. Total OKLCH lightness variation no more than 0.08; hue drift no more than 3 degrees; chroma drift no more than 0.015. Micro-volume visible at full size but nearly gone at 32px.
Forbid: discrete highlight patches, highlight blobs, overlay bands, nested shadows, cut-paper layers, cel shading, stepped tonal swatches, hard internal shadow contours, small glossy hotspots, independent lighting on eyes or seed, realistic 3D, clay, porcelain, plastic, toy rendering, texture, gloss, bevel, extrusion, cast shadow, text, watermark, sharp points, extra colors, extra dots, mouth, or extra anatomy.
attempts.review: Rejected: the navy field visibly vignetted and the mark stayed centered instead of emerging from the lower-left.

attempts.prompt:

Asset type: Palari V2 avatar icon, targeted retry
Primary request: Create a minimal logo for the fluted column Palari in Image 1. Preserve two broad rounded split-petal crown lobes, a tall flared column, one long forest-green #174D38 vertical oval, one raised greeting arm, one resting arm, and the exact small six-dot seed. Anchor/emerge from lower-left.

Image 1 is identity reference only. Generate a new logo; do not edit the reference and do not inherit its scene, lighting, texture, material realism, or shadow.

This targeted retry MUST correct these logo failures:
- The background must be a mathematically uniform-looking, pixel-flat edge-to-edge solid #172333 with ZERO visible variation. No radial gradient, directional gradient, vignette, glow, halo, spotlight, texture, shadow, floor, border, frame, white margin, rounded-corner mask, or transparency.
- Flat-first vector geometry, not an illustration. No cast shadows, contact shadows, occlusion seams, bevels, extrusion, layered paper, ceramic/plastic/clay/toy rendering, gloss, texture, or realistic depth.

Use exactly three semantic colors and no others: warm ivory #E9E6DF shell and arms; assigned characteristic color for exactly one large continuous aperture plus both tiny eye marks and exactly six seed dots; #172333 background only. Exactly two broad rounded fingerless tubular arms; no human anatomy or legs. One dominant continuous rounded silhouette made from 6–10 broad shapes; seed is the only micro-detail. Square native output with square corners. Text and watermark forbidden.
attempts.review: Selected as the best available result. The retry anchors the compact column to the lower-left and preserves its crown, greeting pose, oval, two eyes, and exact six seed dots; a faint navy vignette remains.
